item.title: Release 2026.04.25 (build 6)
item.description:
Summary

  • Added a light/dark/system appearance toggle and refreshed the macOS toolbar/board chrome for a more native look.
  • Improved section navigation and window titling: section labels now appear in the toolbar, with better jump-button visibility and off-screen section access.
  • Standardized floating pills and source/task controls, including consistent sizing, clearer labels, and better placement around the board.
  • Updated the board layout and visuals: refined lane spacing/alignment, softer lane tints, tinted glass lane containers, and new background image assets.
  • Fixed search and focus behavior, including more stable toolbar actions, no unwanted refocus after exiting search, and fewer async warnings.
  • Improved release/test automation: fixed single-worker test execution, removed a problematic parallel-testing setting, and added release checks/Discord notification requirements.
  • Added usability improvements for source links and Linear integration, including opening tickets in the Linear desktop app and always showing source links.

Details

  • [Added] feat(ui): add light/dark/system appearance mode toggle to toolbar
  • [Added] feat(ui): move snoozed quests to floating pill row above bottom-leading cluster
  • [Added] feat(ui): resize floating pills to match system toolbar button height
  • [Added] feat(ui): standardize all floating pills to 30pt height
  • [Added] feat(ui): nudge section pill into toolbar band to match item height
  • [Added] feat(ui): show section label as glass pill overlay at top center
  • [Added] feat(ui): move section label to left of toolbar with more padding
  • [Added] feat(ui): show section label in toolbar instead of window title
  • [Added] feat(ui): window title is always Underway or On Deck
  • [Added] feat(ui): window title shows section only in white
  • [Added] feat(ui): show current board section in title
  • [Added] feat(ui): source pills at full opacity, hover states deferred
  • [Added] feat(ui): simplify source pill text and pill foreground colors
  • [Added] feat(ui): align source pills and triage button to lane HSB values
  • [Added] feat(ui): tune lane tint HSB values via playground
  • [Added] feat(playground): add LaneColorTunerView for live HSB lane tint tuning
  • [Added] feat(ui): tinted glass lane containers for underway and on-deck columns
  • [Added] feat(assets): replace procedural gradient background with image assets
  • [Added] feat(assets): add background images
  • [Added] feat(release): require AI summary and post Discord notification on release
  • [Added] feat(ui): add section jump buttons for off-screen underway and on-deck
  • [Added] feat(ui): anchor snoozed to the window bottom (BUN-301)
  • [Added] feat: replace completed lane with today counter
  • [Added] feat(ui): rework source capsule and filter chips
  • [Added] feat(linear): open ticket links in Linear desktop app
  • [Added] feat(ui): label source action with concrete source name
  • [Added] feat(ui): always show source links and move status history to diagnostics
  • [Fixed] fix(release): correct xcodebuild flag for single-worker test run
  • [Fixed] fix(release): run tests with a single worker to prevent parallel suite interference
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): simplify section jump pill visibility and fix visibleSection tracking
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): set window title immediately when view attaches to window
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): soften on deck lane tint
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): left align quest lanes
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): tune quest card and lane spacing
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): stabilize unified toolbar backdrop
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): set window background color to prevent opaque toolbar on launch
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): task count pill includes both on-deck and underway quests
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): avoid getHue on dynamic NSColor in deepenedSourceColor
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): restore underway section min-height reservation after lane refactor
  • [Fixed] fix(board): align on deck header jump position
  • [Fixed] fix(board): refine jump button visibility
  • [Fixed] fix: keep completed counter hierarchy stable
  • [Fixed] fix(ui): stabilize toolbar actions and use native macOS style
  • [Fixed] fix: stop search refocus on focus-exit and clear async warnings
  • [Internal] revert: remove parallel-testing-worker-count from publish script
  • [Internal] Revert "fix(ui): set window title immediately when view attaches to window"
  • [Internal] Revert "feat(ui): window title shows section only in white"
  • [Internal] Revert "refactor(ui): use toolbarColorScheme(.dark) for white title text"
  • [Internal] refactor(ui): use toolbarColorScheme(.dark) for white title text
  • [Internal] refactor(ui): attach board search to root toolbar host
  • [Internal] chore: remove dead gradient color constants from QuestBoardPalette
  • [Internal] Revert "fix(ui): set window background color to prevent opaque toolbar on launch"
  • [Internal] refactor(ui): update pill labels for clarity
  • [Internal] refactor(ui): merge underway/on-deck jump buttons into single bottom-trailing pill
  • [Internal] refactor(ui): align completed-today pill to floating pill standard
  • [Internal] Fix start quest wiring in board hosts
  • [Internal] refactor(ui): simplify board chrome and on-deck surfaces
  • [Internal] refactor: standardize floating board pills
  • [Internal] Stage first underway reveal in two passes
  • [Internal] Stabilize empty underway scroll behavior
  • [Internal] Refine native board scroll restoration
  • [Internal] refactor: remove legacy quest chrome surface/footer
